text: This report recommends that City Council approve an application under Sections 33 and 34(1)1 of the Ontario Heritage Act to alter and demolish specified heritage attributes at the designated heritage properties at 835 to 839 Yonge Street. This report is in connection with the submitted Zoning By-law Amendment application for a mixed-use building with two tower elements of 41 and 49 storeys in height, containing 922 residential units and a minimum of 750 square metres of non-residential space. This report also seeks approval to enter into a Heritage Easement Agreement to ensure the long-term conservation of the heritage property. The subject properties are located at the northeast corner of the intersection of Yonge/ Church Streets and Davenport Road, across from the Masonic Temple and adjacent to the South Rosedale Heritage Conservation District.
